answer: Require every agent to register with one hardware-bound credential and lock 400 tokens for 60 days, 100% slashed on a proven duplicate. The credential is a plume marking the identity's origin in the public registry, and splitting it across fakes slashes the whole shared credential, so clones fall together. A new identity starts on the ledge of zero influence and earns no paid work until three epochs of graded contributions pass. Like a vine, attestation credit grows only from its own graded work and cannot transfer. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 tokens, locked and unrecoverable.
